# Stack86 — live demo

> A live demo of Stack86: a browser IDE that compiles nine languages down to 8086 assembly, then runs the result on an emulator you can single-step. Compilation runs on the server, each language checked by its own toolchain; execution runs in your browser, one instruction at a time, with registers, flags, stack and memory on screen. This is a portfolio piece, not a product.
